title: estate.survey — input
description: Selects the scope to survey. An absent scope means the whole estate visible to this machine.

value.description: Required for kind=owner (an org login) and kind=project (a project: id). Ignored for kind=estate.

includeExternal.description: Include repositories owned by third parties that are merely cloned here.

asOfScanId.description: The scan the caller wants the answer compared against. RECORDED, NOT HONOURED: the registry is not versioned per scan, so the answer always carries the current estate and `scanId` names the scan it reflects. A pin to any other recorded scan is reported in `degraded` rather than silently applied — measured 2026-09-08, a pin two days old returned identical counts. Whether to honour it is OQ-0016.

limit.description: Return at most this many projects. Omit for all of them. There is no default on purpose: a default page size would truncate every existing caller's answer silently, and an answer must declare what it left out. An estate survey is about 30,000 tokens unpaged (measured 2026-09-07: 119,288 bytes for 152 projects; one project is 2,785).

cursor.description: Continue after this project id, taken from a previous answer's nextCursor. Pair it with asOfScanId: ordering is by project id and is stable, but a project appearing between two calls would shift an unpinned walk.
